description:
TESTS-006: Framework documentation is out of sync with the implementation: `print_test_summary()` now counts skipped tests, but the early example and prose still describe only passed/failed counts. Update the documentation so manual test operators understand skipped optional properties and do not mistake skips for missing coverage. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000035.json (category: quality, blocking: no).
